candidates.statement: [10, Theorem 4.24] Let K be any oriented knot, and let ospJλ K(q), soJλ K(q) ∈Q(q, t)τ be the λ-colored osp and so knot invariants. Then ospJλ K(q) = t⋆(K,λ)soJλ K(t−1q) for some ⋆(K, λ) ∈ Z. In particular, the Uq(osp(1|2))-invariant in the variable q is just the Jones polynomial in the variable τ −1q. If T+, T−, T0 are unframed oriented links that diﬀer as shown below T+ T− T0 , then (τ −1q)−2J1 T+ −(τ −1q)2J1 T−= (τq−1 −τ−1q)J1 T0. (1.1) However, a categoriﬁcation of this invariant has not been discovered as of yet. 1.1. Results. In this paper, we also construct an invariant bJ of oriented links using the representation theory of osp(1|2).
